title: VerificationRecipe.v1
description: The recipe that turns one or more SourceRecipes + an ExtractorSnippet into a repeatable VERIFICATION for a fact_key — the heart of the M3 rung. It pins the fact_key, the input SourceRecipe ids, the extractor that reads them, the validators + success criteria the extracted value must pass, and (REQUIRED) an authority policy + a cross_source confirmation policy + a freshness policy. Running it produces a FactVerificationRun (a candidate result + receipt), NEVER a served fact: a recipe verifies, it does not promote. tenant_scope keeps tenant_private verification from leaking. Deterministic when created_at is injected.

recipe_id.description: content-addressed over (fact_key, extractor_id, source recipe ids); version in metadata, never in the id

input_source_recipe_ids.description: the SourceRecipe(s) feeding this verification (the inputs to cross-source confirmation)

extractor_id.description: the ExtractorSnippet that reads the source(s) into a candidate value

validators.description: the deterministic validators the extracted value must pass

success_criteria.description: what counts as a successful verification (e.g. 'value parses as a business-day duration AND matches the official source hash')

authority.description: REQUIRED — the authority policy: which source_type wins, the minimum authority rank to accept

winning_source_type.description: only high-authority types may win a verification — a FAQ cannot be the winning source

cross_source.description: REQUIRED — the cross-source confirmation policy this verification enforces

freshness.description: REQUIRED — how fresh a source read must be for the verification to count

requires_fresh_for_current_values.description: current/rate/fee/deadline facts require a fresh source read, not a cached one

tenant_scope.description: REQUIRED — the scope this verification's result is valid in; a tenant_private verification can never publish a global fact

produces.description: pinned — running this recipe yields a FactVerificationRun (candidate + receipt), NEVER a served/canonical fact
